queries_run: MercadoLibre agentic commerce AI shopping agents threat 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 風險因子：競爭者可能比 MELI 更快、更有效地回應新興技術（含 AI/ML 實際應用），且投入更多資源；MELI 須預判技術發展。
findings.excerpt: Our competitors may respond to new or emerging technologies and capabilities, including practical applications of AI/ML, as well as changes in customer requirements, faster and more effectively than we may, and they may also devote greater resources to the development, promotion, and sale of products and services.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：MELI 的 app 依賴 Apple/Google 應用商店，抽成 15%–30%，並有反導流限制。
findings.excerpt: typically subject to commissions ranging from 15% to 30% of the transaction value, restrictions on informing users of alternative payment channels (anti-steering)

substitute_technology.note: 僅搜尋 1 次；搜尋摘要為二手、未取得可逐字原文，未列入 findings。摘要提及管理層稱 AI 代理購物對營收影響尚難衡量、自建購物助理（Q4 FY25 財報電話會議）。
